messages.subject: For Francisca Matos | Director-Level External Affairs, ESG & Energy Transition Executive
messages.body:
Dear EDP Talent Acquisition Team,

For the attention of Francisca Matos, Head of Talent Acquisition.

I am reaching out regarding senior international leadership opportunities across EDP where external affairs, government relations, sustainability, stakeholder strategy and energy-transition execution intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation undergoing substantial investment and energy-transition activity.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest fit is in Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Corporate Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership.

EDP's international footprint and focus on the energy transition make the group especially relevant to my next move. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation and expatriate assignments.

I have attached an EDP-tailored executive CV for review. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming mandates, or referral to the appropriate regional leadership recruiter.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
